This bench is sturdy and easy to assemble. It arrived with a terrible smell of pesticides or something which was hard to get out of the house after. Assemble outdoors and dispose of packing materials quickly. Love the product so much

Articolo consigliato

Needed a trainer stand and decided to go with this; it is 1/4 of the price compared to the Wahoo stand. I had my reservations but was very surprised by the quality of the stand. It is 90% metal construction, and the desk side is very high-quality plastic with pedding. Delighted with the purchase. Highly recommended.
Perfect for the price. only little error is that one of the push buttons to adjust the hight is a little so so. but everything works.

La mesa es estable y los componentes son de buena calidad. No obstante, en mi unidad las soldaduras donde encajan los brazos verticales en la base no están hechas completamente a escuadra y como resultado los brazos no quedan paralelos. Entonces rozan lateralmente en uno de los alojamientos de plástico donde el brazo conecta con la bandeja y ya no suben y bajan libres, hay que hacer algo de fuerza para que hagan clic en la altura elegida. Si no se pone algo de cierto peso en la bandeja se quedará torcida porque el brazo recto queda suelto en su alojamiento y cae por su propia gravedad pero el "torcido" roza y no cae hasta que no se le ponga peso (con un móvil o una tablet ni se inmutaba). La solución es calzar en los lados opuestos donde los brazos atornillan a la base, en un lado en el interior y en el otro exterior hasta que ambos brazos suban y bajen libres. En mi caso tenía a mano calzas de latón y tuve que apilar unas 10 en cada lado, casi 2mm. Si no tienes se puede usar papel de aluminio o mejor tiras de latas de refresco cortadas. Quedó perfecto y cuesta menos de la mitad que otros modelos similares.
Nice and light. The seat is a bit harder than expected.:)
great product for a quick walk way! Easy to install and price and delivery were great!

First I have to say that those that where attaching the stakes to the stepping stones and they had broken off obviously did NOT read the instructions properly. ( READING IS FUNDIMENTAL) Make sure you angle the stakes when snapping them in! Sooooo easy. For those who said there are voids and when you step on them they crack. I used sand before staking them not only to level the stepping stones, but to have the sand fill the voids underneath so you have a bit more strength to it because the voids are filled. You are going to kill the grass under it anyway, the filling the voids with sand will make it structurely sound when walking on it. Great buy for the price. Easy to assemble, pretty solid. I used it as tile for under my gazebo so I could eliminate dirt and ants.
Perfect choice for the price, a little thicker would have been great, but yes, great looking product,
